invariants.rationale: instantTime is passed to commitInternal and likely identifies a commit instant.
partitionRecordsMap is passed directly to commitInternal and must be non-null.
partitionRecordsMap being empty implies its size is 0.
Partition names (keys) should be non-null and non-empty.
All HoodieData<HoodieRecord> in the map should be non-null for commitInternal to process them.
